mined_task_summaries: bug_repair: a reporting endpoint aggregates by event names that the ingestion endpoint never accepts, so several funnel counters are permanently zero
bug_repair: a page links to a mutating endpoint with a read method, so the call fails with a method error instead of starting the purchase flow
bug_repair: a payment session request includes an unsupported field that the provider rejects, breaking every checkout attempt
bug_repair: integer division based half-up rounding is wrong for negative operands and for a negative divisor in a money scaling helper
bug_repair: a currency formatter mixes locale aware grouping with a hard coded decimal separator and code prefix, contradicting its own documented output and an existing test
bug_repair: a money formatter funnels a wide integer through a floating point conversion before grouping, losing digits near the supported maximum
bug_repair: a return calculation inverts the sign of its result when the baseline value is negative, reporting a gain as a loss
bug_repair: a submission handler maps every unexpected failure including a storage outage to a client side validation error status
bug_repair: a form collects several contact fields that the persistence layer silently discards because the table has no columns for them
bug_repair: an idempotency token for an outbound notification is regenerated on every attempt, so a retry sends the message twice
bug_repair: a client treats a partial success where the record was stored but the notification was not as a total failure and invites a duplicate submission
bug_repair: a handler conflates a wrong request method with an oversized payload and answers both with the payload too large status
bug_repair: a size guard trusts a declared length header and lets a request with no declared length through, so the cap can be bypassed
bug_repair: a throttling key is derived from a client supplied forwarding header without trusted proxy depth, letting a caller rotate keys and bypass limits
bug_repair: a fixed window counter lets a caller spend double the intended budget by straddling the window boundary
bug_repair: a byte range proxy marks a partial response as publicly cacheable without varying on the range header, so a shared cache can serve truncated content to other callers
bug_repair: a proxy endpoint has no upstream timeout or cancellation, so a hung origin holds the request open indefinitely while a sibling endpoint handles it correctly
bug_repair: a compiler target too old for large integer literals breaks the type check of a new numeric module
bug_repair: a pipeline enables the dependency cache for a package manager before the step that installs it, so the cache step fails
bug_repair: a tracked secret scan only matches one vendor token prefix in a few source extensions, missing configuration and documentation files
bug_repair: three checked in tooling configuration files are structurally corrupt with duplicated keys and mangled text, so the tools that read them cannot parse them
bug_repair: an in memory throttle store only prunes expired entries above a large threshold and starts a timer at import time in every runtime
bug_repair: an origin validator accepts an insecure scheme in every environment that is not the production one, including preview and test
bug_repair: a form submit handler short circuits on a type check against a global that is absent in some runtimes, so submitting does nothing
bug_repair: a metrics endpoint serves business aggregates with no authentication while an equivalent owner scoped endpoint requires a session
bug_repair: a database module filters out loopback connection strings and falls back to an unreachable placeholder, so local development fails every query with a service unavailable answer
bug_repair: a conversion back from integer minor units uses floating point division, so the documented exact round trip does not hold for large values

net_new: add request level protection for a private area so an unauthenticated visitor is redirected before the protected shell renders
net_new: replace a single hard coded administrator identity with a role model, membership storage, and checks at every privileged entry point
net_new: convert a buffered assistant endpoint to incremental streaming with cancellation while keeping the existing non streaming fallback contract
net_new: add a caching layer with background refresh and a failure breaker in front of a slow third party data source
net_new: add duplicate detection and merging to an inbound contact pipeline using a normalized contact fingerprint and a time window
net_new: write operator actions to an existing but unused audit table with a consistent shape and read them back in a dashboard
net_new: wire an existing exact integer money library into the interface estimator and the catalog so displayed figures stop using floating point
net_new: build an integration test harness for request handlers with injectable storage, mailer, and clock so routes can be exercised without network access
net_new: replace client generated analytics identity with a server issued session, an origin check, and automated traffic filtering
net_new: implement a projection engine that compounds a return over a horizon entirely in integer minor units with documented rounding
net_new: add a time series metrics endpoint with range selection, server side bucketing, and stable ordering
net_new: add consent gating so a page level beacon only fires after the visitor has agreed, with a durable preference
net_new: add an outbound notification queue with bounded retries, exponential backoff, and a dead letter path
net_new: implement correct partial content serving with range validation, resumable transfers, and accurate length and range headers
net_new: move a hard coded catalog array into the database and expose filtering and cursor pagination over it

repo_evolution: extract translation strings from a large client page into a message catalog with locale negotiation and real translations for the aliased languages
repo_evolution: split a single oversized client page into server rendered sections and small client islands, moving data fetching to the server

repo_evolution: centralize scattered environment variable reads with multiple fallback names into one validated configuration module
repo_evolution: replace module level singletons for the connection pool and the throttle store with injected context so handlers become testable
repo_evolution: unify two overlapping conversation endpoints and three separate chat surfaces behind one shared conversation module
repo_evolution: replace ad hoc standalone test scripts with one runner that covers handlers and is wired into the quality gate
repo_evolution: move duplicated provider model identifiers and assistant identifiers into one typed configuration shared by server and client
